privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Privacy policy of Ayiti Dijital, GDPR.
privacy.intro: We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This policy describes which data we collect, why, and your rights.

summary_points.title: We don't track you.
summary_points.body: No advertising cookies, no third-party pixels, no fingerprinting on this site.

summary_points.title: Privacy-friendly analytics.
summary_points.body: We use Plausible Analytics, hosted in the European Union, with no cookies and no personal data.

summary_points.title: Membership data on consent.
summary_points.body: We only store your details if you voluntarily fill in a form (membership, contact).

privacy.controller_body: Ayiti Dijital e.V., Munich, Germany, kontakt@ayitidijital.org
privacy.data_body: This site does not set any tracking cookies. We only collect personal data when you voluntarily transmit it via a form (membership, contact). This data is stored on European servers and used only to process your request.
privacy.cookies_intro: For full transparency, here is everything this site stores in your browser:

cookies_rows.purpose: No cookies are set by this site

cookies_rows.name: localStorage (UI preferences)
cookies_rows.purpose: Remember your chosen language or menu state

privacy.cookies_note: Our analytics tool, Plausible Analytics, sets no cookies and uses no persistent identifier.
privacy.rights_intro: The GDPR grants you a set of rights over your personal data. To exercise them, write to kontakt@ayitidijital.org, we respond within 30 days.

rights_cards.title: Right of access
rights_cards.body: Obtain a copy of the data we hold about you.

rights_cards.title: Right to rectification
rights_cards.body: Correct any inaccurate or incomplete data.

rights_cards.title: Right to erasure
rights_cards.body: Request deletion of your data, unless a legal obligation requires otherwise.

rights_cards.title: Right to restriction
rights_cards.body: Restrict the processing of your data in certain cases.

rights_cards.title: Right to portability
rights_cards.body: Receive your data in a structured, reusable format.

rights_cards.title: Right to object
rights_cards.body: Object to the processing of your data at any time.

privacy.rights_complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Bavarian data protection authority (BayLfD): datenschutz-bayern.de.
privacy.hosting_body: This site is hosted on infrastructure located in the European Union. No third-party analytics or advertising tools are used.
privacy.contact_body: For any question about the protection of your data, exercising your rights, complaints, requests, write to us directly.
